sentences.text:
Vipin And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16
November, 2023

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:217331
Court No. - 89
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 41954 of 2023
Applicant :- Vipin And 5 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Pundir
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Gaurav Pundir, learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.1481 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No.41 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, P.S. Nagfani, District Moradabad, pending in the court of JM,
Moradabad.

entities.text: DP Act, P.S. Nagfani, District Moradabad
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicant No.1 is husband of opposite party No.2 and opposite party No.2 has lodged FIR under the aforesaid sections against applicant No.1 Vipin And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16618335/
1 and his family members.

entities.text: Vipin And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicants and opposite party no.2 have amicably settled their dispute out of the Court.

Applicants earlier approached this Hon'ble Court by filing Application U/s 482 No.24674 of 2023 with prayer to quash the proceedings on terms of compromise entered between the parties, the Hon'ble Court vide order dated 13.07.2023 sent the matter to trial court for verification of the parties and compromise application.
Trial court vide order dated 22.09.2023 verified the parties as well as compromise application.
He further submitted that applicants and opposite party no.2 compromised the matter and opposite party No.2 does not want to proceed the matter against the applicants.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants in support of his contention has placed reliance on the judgments of Apex Court in the case of Narinder Singh vs. State of Punjab reported in (2014) 6 SCC 466, and has submitted that the applicants and opposite party no.2 have settled through compromise their private and civil dispute and as such opposite party no.2 does not wish to press the aforesaid case against the applicants.

entities.text: Narinder Singh vs. State of Punjab reported in (2014) 6 SCC 466
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Opposite party no.2 is ready to withdraw the prosecution of the applicants and in view of the compromise, no fruitful purpose would be served if the prosecution is allowed to go on.

5. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no.2 does not dispute the correctness of the submission made by learned counsel for the applicants or the correctness of the documents relied upon by him.
He submits that opposite party no. 2 has no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.
6. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

7. The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab, (2014) 6 SCC 466, Parbatbhai Aahir @ Parbatbhai Vs. State of Gujarat (2017) 9 SCC, 641, Gian Singh Vs.
State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303 and State of M.P. Vs. Laxmi Narayanan (2019) 5 SCC 688,
wherein Hon'ble Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain cognizable and non-compoundable offences.

entities.text: Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab, (2014) 6 SCC 466
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Parbatbhai Aahir @ Parbatbhai Vs. State of Gujarat (2017) 9 SCC, 641
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Gian Singh Vs.
State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: State of M.P. Vs. Laxmi Narayanan (2019) 5 SCC 688
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83) ACC 278], in which, law expounded by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

entities.text: Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83) ACC 278]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

9. Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Case No.1481 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No.41 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, P.S. Nagfani, District Moradabad, pending in the court of JM, Moradabad is hereby quashed.
10. This application under Section 482 CrPC is accordingly allowed.
Order Date :- 16.11.2023 Nitin Verma  Vipin And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 November, 2023
